claims.object_text: component of the GATOR1 complex; modulator of the mTOR pathway
claims.quote: DEPDC5, NPRL2 and NPRL3 that encode the GATOR1 (GTPase-activating protein towards the Rags 1) complex, a modulator in the mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR) pathway

claims.object_text: prevalence of pathogenic DEPDC5 variants in cohort
claims.quote: Two novel frameshift variants and one recurrent nonsense variant were detected in DEPDC5, with a prevalence of 1.8% (3 out of 170) in the whole cohort and 3.1% (3 out of 97) in focal epilepsies.

claims.object_text: variants cosegregated with epilepsy in pedigrees
claims.quote: These variants cosegregated in pedigrees with epilepsy, respectively.

claims.object_text: focal seizures with non-lesional variable foci predominantly sleep-related; median onset age 10 years (range 1-30)
claims.quote: Epileptic phenotypes of 21 patients with DEPDC5 variants showed focal seizures with non-lesional variable foci that were predominantly sleep-related, with a median onset age of 10 years (range 1-30).

claims.object_text: drug-resistant epilepsy in ~24% of patients with DEPDC5 variants
seizure attacks absent in 33% of variant carriers
claims.quote: seizure attacks were absent in 33% of variant carriers.

claims.object_text: seizures tended to resolve spontaneously in 54% of affected patients
claims.quote: Of 13 patients who experienced seizures, 54% tended to resolve spontaneously.
These loss-of-function (LoF) variants affected the DEPDC5-dependent inhibition of mTOR.

claims.object_text: loss of inhibition of the mTOR pathway causes the associated epilepsy
claims.quote: The associated epilepsy was caused by loss of inhibition of the mTOR pathway.

claims.object_text: DEPDC5-LoF carriers might show high prevalence of focal seizures with dynamic phenotype, reduced penetrance and self-resolving features
claims.quote: Patients carrying DEPDC5-LoF variants might show a high prevalence of focal seizures with a dynamic phenotype, indicating reduced penetrance and self-resolving features.
